properties.description:
BUILT AND VERIFIED 2026-10-29 (commit 94ecdda9c: excerpt_of and SearchHit.excerpt in crates/reflow2-core/src/search.rs, the output schema in tools/query.rs), increment 2. From fact:root-cause-a-budget-limited-reader-was-not-cued-to-the-designs-current-state-record-2026-10-29, candidate (3): the record that said where things stood was a Fragment with no name, and search_design rendered it as `name: ""`. Measured on the pilot design (0.93.1): "current state" ranks four frag:state-as-of-* records first, all blank, and a Question hit (q:sms-alarm-source) blank too.

THE CHANGE: a hit whose node has no name gains `excerpt`, the first non-empty of its title, statement, question, summary, description (then any other searched prose field), whitespace collapsed, at most 160 characters, ending in … when cut. `name` stays exactly as it was (empty), so no client reading it sees a change; a hit with a name gets no excerpt. Additive, served on the search_design output schema. This is what makes the second half of the first-read cue (search_design for the design's own current-state record) readable from the hit list.
properties.name: A search hit on a node with no name carries a short excerpt of its own text, so a Fragment or Question no longer reads blank
